source_reduction.rule: A preserved reduction is a mechanically reduced copy of the official source image, not a redrawn or reinterpreted sprite.

gba_derivative.rule: Any palette reduction, transparency extraction, framing change, or GBA-specific packing must be stored as a separate derived asset and must never overwrite the preserved reduction.

front_sheet.bootstrap_rule: duplicate the validated 64x64 source front frame until authored frame 2 exists

notes: Gameplay sprites are project assets derived from recorded source provenance; they are not represented as official Emerald sprites.
Do not introduce antialiasing or interpolation colors during conversion.
Preserved reductions must remain byte-separate from later GBA palette-constrained derivatives.
Shiny initially reuses the normal palette unless a separately identified gameplay alternate palette is authored.
